title: Sendium - SMS Operations
description: Operational overview, not billing or a message ledger. Submissions, provider-part attempts and final receipt outcomes use different units. Raw totals are since application start at the selected range end, not selected-period increments. Rates follow the time picker. Provider load/results repeat side by side and share a scale within each group. All charts are unstacked; filled areas show individual series, not cumulative totals. No data is not zero.

panels.title: Since application start - submissions, parts and receipts are different units
Accepted submissions - since start
panels.description: Raw accepted ingress decisions. A long HTTP message is one submission but may produce several provider parts; SMPP multipart ingress counts accepted parts. Not unique customer SMS or billable units. Resets on restart; evaluated at range end, not a count within the selected period.

panels.title: SMS-part send attempts - since start
panels.description: Each provider-part request invocation, including initial sends, retries and requests later rejected or timed out. Not unique parts, accepted provider parts or billable units. Resets on restart; evaluated at range end.

panels.title: Delivered receipt outcomes - since start
panels.description: Committed delivered correlation-state transitions after multipart aggregation. Provider acceptance alone is not delivery. Not a conversion rate of submissions from this period. Resets on restart; evaluated at range end.

panels.title: Failed / expired receipt outcomes - since start
panels.description: Final provider-reported failures/expiry, not admission rejections, submission failures or callback failures. No series is No data, not an invented zero. Resets on restart; evaluated at range end.

panels.title: Incoming traffic - what Sendium accepts and rejects
Accepted / rejected submissions per second
panels.description: Admission decisions separated by HTTP/SMPP and result. Includes authentication/validation/capacity rejections recognized as SMS submissions; not provider rejections.

panels.title: Accepted submissions per second by account and ingress
panels.description: Trusted credential accountId across HTTP/SMPP. Credentials sharing accountId aggregate within each protocol. Missing accountId is omitted; rejected traffic is not attributed. Not provider/receipt attribution or billing.

panels.title: Providers - outgoing part load and response problems
$provider - SMS-part send attempts per second
panels.description: One repeated panel per selected provider, unstacked initial/retry rates. Multipart submissions generate several parts; attempts are not necessarily accepted. Both provider panels use the same scale: an invisible reference includes the busiest outgoing provider's total part-attempt rate. The reference is not additional traffic and is hidden from legend/tooltip.

panels.title: $provider - response results per second
panels.description: One unstacked panel per selected provider: accepted, rejected, timeout, transport_error or protocol_error. A rejection is not a failed final delivery receipt. An invisible reference to the largest provider/result rate gives panels in this group a common scale; it is not traffic and is hidden from legend/tooltip.

panels.title: Provider rejection percentage
panels.description: Explicit rejected responses divided by all completed provider attempts in the rate window. Timeouts/transport/protocol failures are separate results, not rejections. No completed activity means no percentage, not 0%. Not a delivery-failure percentage.

panels.title: Progress - backlog, final delivery results and receipt forwarding
Pending retained sources
panels.description: Trend of currently retained ingress sources, including later Selected/Routed ownership and bookkeeping. Not an exact waiting-to-send queue. Sustained growth warrants investigation. Detailed stage/snapshot queries remain in the metrics reference.

panels.title: Delivered / failed / expired receipt outcomes per second
panels.description: Committed final receipt transitions after multipart aggregation, separated by configured receipt-provider identity and outcome. Receipt-provider labels may differ from outgoing worker names. Not a conversion funnel or submission-rejection count.

panels.title: Receipt forwarding failures per second
panels.description: Failed logical attempts to forward receipts to the submitting application, split by HTTP/SMPP. These are callback/client-return failures, not handset delivery failures. Retries can refer to the same receipt.

panels.title: Queue details - overlapping ownership; do not add Pending, Selected and Routed
panels.description: Expand to investigate where retained work is accumulating. Source, selection and provider-part counts are different units.

panels.title: Selected work by state
panels.description: Selections waiting for or undergoing routing, plus retained bookkeeping after assignment. Overlaps Pending sources; not an independent queue to add to Pending. Only waiting/routing occupy unassigned Selected capacity.

panels.title: Routed work by destination and state
panels.description: Selections assigned to outgoing destinations. Waiting is before destination take; active includes preparation, provider processing/retries and handoff; terminal awaits cleanup. Overlaps Pending/Selected ownership, not provider requests in flight. Waiting excludes preparation FIFO.
